# snomed-rust

> SNOMED CT tooling for Rust: RF2 release file parsing, SCTID validation, an
> in-memory snapshot store with hierarchy queries, ECL (Expression
> Constraint Language), FHIR terminology building blocks, OWL axiom
> parsing, and EL-profile subsumption classification with necessary normal
> form generation. Nine published crates, zero external dependencies.

Independent community project, not affiliated with, endorsed by, or
certified by SNOMED International. Ships no SNOMED CT content — release
files are licensed material obtained under your own affiliate license.
SNOMED®, SNOMED CT®, and IHTSDO® are registered trademarks of International
Health Terminology Standards Development Organisation (IHTSDO). Use of the
trademarks does not constitute endorsement of this product by IHTSDO.

Links below are repo-relative and resolve inside this git checkout (e.g.
on GitHub, GitLab, or Codeberg); see `spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md`.
The project homepage serves website-appropriate versions of this file at
[snomed-rust.github.io/llms.txt](https://snomed-rust.github.io/llms.txt).

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, workspace layout, quickstart
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md): install and run
- [index.md](index.md): documentation map — which layer answers which question
- [docs/tutorial.md](docs/tutorial.md): guided, runnable, six-step walkthrough
- [snomed-rust.github.io](https://snomed-rust.github.io/): project homepage

## Specification (normative single source of truth)

- [spec/README.md](spec/README.md): index of every spec and project policy
- [spec/01-overview.md](spec/01-overview.md): RF2 goals, terminology, scope
- [spec/04-sctid.md](spec/04-sctid.md): SCTID structure, partitions, Verhoeff check digit
- [spec/09-versioning.md](spec/09-versioning.md): effectiveTime, active, moduleId, snapshot semantics
- [spec/10-ecl.md](spec/10-ecl.md): Expression Constraint Language grammar and every ECL rule number
- [spec/11-fhir.md](spec/11-fhir.md): FHIR `$lookup`/`$subsumes`/`$expand`
- [spec/12-owl.md](spec/12-owl.md): OWL 2 functional-syntax subset used in the OWL Expression refset
- [spec/13-classification.md](spec/13-classification.md): EL-profile subsumption classification
- [spec/14-necessary-normal-form.md](spec/14-necessary-normal-form.md): necessary normal form (RF2 relationship) generation

## Crates

- [crates/snomed](crates/snomed/README.md): facade crate — re-exports everything, `prelude`, end-to-end tests
- [crates/snomed-core](crates/snomed-core/README.md): SCTID, `EffectiveTime`, component structs, well-known constants (no dependencies beyond std)
- [crates/snomed-rf2](crates/snomed-rf2/README.md): file naming, streaming reader, refset member types
- [crates/snomed-store](crates/snomed-store/README.md): snapshot builder, IS-A hierarchy, subsumption, full version history
- [crates/snomed-ecl](crates/snomed-ecl/README.md): Expression Constraint Language lexer, parser, evaluator
- [crates/snomed-fhir](crates/snomed-fhir/README.md): FHIR terminology service building blocks
- [crates/snomed-owl](crates/snomed-owl/README.md): OWL 2 functional-syntax parser
- [crates/snomed-classify](crates/snomed-classify/README.md): EL subsumption classifier, necessary normal form generation
- [crates/snomed-cli](crates/snomed-cli/README.md): `snomed-cli` binary — `sctid`, `load`, `lookup`, `ecl`, `export`, `validate`, `classify`, `nnf`

## Project policies

- [spec/rust-msrv-n-minus-2/index.md](spec/rust-msrv-n-minus-2/index.md): Minimum Supported Rust Version, current stable minus two
- [spec/rust-no-unsafe/index.md](spec/rust-no-unsafe/index.md): no `unsafe` anywhere, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` at every crate root
- [spec/rust-api-stability.md](spec/rust-api-stability.md): which public enums are `#[non_exhaustive]`, and why the ASTs are not
- [spec/rust-fuzz.md](spec/rust-fuzz.md): fuzz targets, the no-panic invariant, seed corpora
- [spec/rust-bench.md](spec/rust-bench.md): criterion benchmarks — what is measured and how
- [spec/docs-budget-and-links/index.md](spec/docs-budget-and-links/index.md): 40 KB per-document budget, link integrity
- [spec/professionalization/index.md](spec/professionalization/index.md): verified plans, accurate special files, CI-backed claims, trademark notice presence
- [spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md](spec/llms-json-and-llms-txt/index.md): this file and `llms.json` — purpose, size budget, and link-target rule
